name: GPU0-3 automated reconstructed reproduction campaign
purpose: Record the GPU0-3 reproduction orchestrator and the first automated reconstructed campaign continuation. The script runs stages sequentially with artifact-based skip/resume, confines model stages to GPU0-3, and separates faithful reruns from reconstructed reruns when original recovered item commands are absent.

commands.purpose: Validate orchestrator syntax, dry-run behavior, and GPU0-3 shard mapping without launching heavy work.
Complete the reconstructed Item123 graph_color C1 matched-budget n64 rerun on GPU0-3.

Run the remaining automated campaign stages sequentially with skip/resume: environment check, GPU preflight, manifest, Item101, graph_color symbolic, external registry, and experiment-log regeneration.

provenance.gpu_scope: GPU0-3 only; no running external process was killed or preempted.
provenance.policy: Run faithful local-command stages when commands exist; otherwise run tracked-runner reconstructed stages and record them as new item evidence.

decision.headline: A resumable GPU0-3 reproduction campaign script now automates the core faithful/reconstructed chain. It completed Item101, graph_color C1, graph_color symbolic A/C, external registry, manifest, and log regeneration; long HB-2 full grids remain opt-in.

gate_outcomes.number: scripts/reproduce_gpu0_3_campaign.sh is executable, bash -n clean, dry-run clean, and uses artifact status checks plus checkpoint/resume. The shell helper was corrected from bash -lc to bash -c to preserve repo cwd.
bf16 reproduces fail: max_delta=0.15625, same-token pass, different-token fail. fp32 now passes tol=1e-3 in this environment: max_delta=3.4332e-05, same-token and different-token pass.
n=64, B*=22901, A=1.0, C=0.40625, A-C=0.59375, conservative gap CI [0.4148,0.7054], promotion=true.
BudgetRunner registry regenerated under the reproduction root; HB-2 full external curves are not run by default.
The manifest keeps 134-148 cluster-missing and many 142-162 summary-only records separate from automated reconstructed reruns.

decision.next_step_routing: Use scripts/reproduce_gpu0_3_campaign.sh as the default continuation entrypoint. Set RUN_EXTERNAL_FULL=1 to run HB-2 LFS/ToT/RAP/best-of-n full grids sequentially on GPU0-3, or set STAGES to target a specific remaining reconstructed suite.

honesty.scope: This item records the automated core continuation, not completion of every historical item in the ledger.
honesty.faithful_vs_reconstructed: A faithful rerun reuses original executable commands. A reconstructed rerun is rebuilt from tracked runners/specs because original commands are absent or only summary-only recovered.
honesty.item101_caveat: Item101 fp32 behavior is environment-sensitive in this rerun: current fp32 passes tolerance while the historical item recorded fp32 fail. bf16 still reproduces the fail-closed signal.
honesty.external_limit: HB-2 external full grids are available through RUN_EXTERNAL_FULL=1 but were intentionally not launched by default in this automated continuation.
honesty.artifact_scope: Large reproduction outputs are kept under results/reproduction_gpu0_3_20260620 and summarized through this item JSON.
